about.hosted: Bikerouter is hosted and developed by Marcus Jaschen. Contact: @bikerouter@en.osm.town
about.introduction: Bikerouter is the perfect way to plan bike routes online and is based on BRouter-Web. BRouter-Web is a project by Norbert Renner, the routing engine BRouter was developed by Arndt Brenschede.
about.manual: The manual for Bikerouter is work in progress and is being created here:
about.routing-data: The routing data is generated directly from OpenStreetMap multiple times every day. The data age can be seen on the timestamp of the data files. (Timestamp in UTC).
about.support: Do you have questions that are not yet answered by the manual and the articles linked on the manual homepage? In the bikerouter.de support forum at MTB-News.de you will definitely get help (alas, in German only). Please understand that I can no longer answer support requests by email – the time required has unfortunately become too much.
about.title: About Bikerouter

about-local-profiles.title: Custom Routing Profiles
about-local-profiles.helptext1: You can save your customizations to routing profiles directly in your browser and also load them from there. No longer needed custom profiles can also be deleted.
about-local-profiles.helptext2: These customizations are only visible for you and in the currently used browser and not for other users.
about-local-profiles.helptext3: If you want to use your custom profiles on other devices, you should save them on your computer. This way you also have a backup in case you reset your browser.
about-local-profiles.helptext4: To transfer custom profiles to another computer, use the settings export feature to download all important Bikerouter settings, including your custom profiles. On the new computer, import the downloaded file using the import settings feature. Export and import buttons are located in the main dropdown menu.

help.heading: How the Router Manager Works
help.line1: The Route Manager lets you save your current route and load previously saved routes in Bikerouter.
help.line2: You can either keep routes only in this browser or store them on Bikerouter’s servers.
help.line3: If you want to save routes on Bikerouter’s servers, you need an account. No email address or personal data is required – just an unique access code.
help.line4: When you register, Bikerouter generates an access code for you. Treat it like a password, as it grants access to all your saved routes. This code is displayed only once after registration and cannot be recovered if lost. It's possible to create a new access code at any time as long as you know the current access code.
help.line5: Important: ‼️ If you lose your access code, you will no longer have access to your saved routes. The code cannot be recovered!
help.line6: Browser storage works without an account. Once logged in to Bikerouter storage, you can also download archives and manage your access code.
